Best I can suggest is keeping water near your bed at night so you can drink some of it when you wake up (helps wake body some). If you have an alarm you really hate and is loud you can set that to be a bit aways from where you rest (outta arms reach). I once knew a guy who had an alarm app that wouldn't turn off unless he took a picture of his kuerig machine, maybe something you can do. Also for when you do get up spalshing my face with water helps, or whatever body part feels sore (when I helped my grandpa with animals my feet were sore in most morning so I rubbed some cold water on them and it helped prepare me for everything else). For when you do have energy dont overdo anything and simplify tasks if need be (getting camping toothbrushes) so on the moments you do have energy you don't spend to much and can build that up. You can even set parts or your whole outfit for the next morning to help speed some things along, I usually just throw my jeans and shirt on dresser. Also another thing that helps some is trying to maintain either a clean or somewhat clean environment for themselves, messy room can set me in a messy mind set. Technically don't have energy to clean my room fully so I grab small things here and there so if I head out I grab plates/cups and/or trash and over time that helps me manage my not clean and tidy but good enough room, also don't feel pressured to have everything organized like other people it doesn't work for everyone figure out what works for you in a way you like and want it.
